headline: Vornado bought a 13-story medical office building at 30 East 40th Street for $28 million at a bankruptcy auction.
GO Partners and RXR listed 265 East 66th Street, a 321-unit Upper East Side rental, for sale.
Kushner and RFR face foreclosure on their three-building Dumbo Heights office campus over a $325 million loan.
The City Council member for Flatbush is calling for a temporary freeze on new development approvals and non-emergency construction in the district.
